surface_mechanism_description: The ALE growth process involved alternate exposures to TEI, PH3, TMGa, and PH3 fluxes. During growth, PH3 flowed continuously on the column V side. While the substrate was under the PH3 flow, TMGa was turned on and allowed to stabilize, and the substrate was rotated one cycle through the TMGa flux back to PH3 to deposit near a monolayer of GaP. TMGa was then turned off and TEI was turned on and stabilized, while traces of TMGa were purged out. The substrate was rotated through the TEI flux back to PH3 to deposit near a monolayer of InP, and thus a Ga-P-In-P structure was deposited.
